messages:
Asha Patel: quick heads-up: we got approval to hire an oncall manager (backfill) plus two ICs to support runtime oncall cadence. posting + start targets below. please react if any conflicts.

Maya R.: great news. can we have names/titles and start windows?

Asha Patel: posting plan: 
- Oncall Manager (backfill) 1 req approved. target posting this week, hiring window 4-6 weeks.
- Senior Oncall Engineer (Ben Wallace) 1 offer extended, tentative start 2026-05-04. relocation support approved.
- Oncall Support Engineer (TBD) 1 new headcount, will prioritize internal referrals for faster ramp.

RecruiterBot: offer sent to Ben Wallace 2026-03-22 14:11 UTC.

Ben Wallace: accepted offer over call, excited to join. will confirm final start after signer paperwork. :grinning:

Lina Chavez: heads up for onboarding: Ill prep a 2-week ramp plan focused on playbooks + runbook walkthroughs. who should lead technical shadowing?

Jordan Kim: I can own the first week of shadowing for incident triage + alert tuning. will add Ben to the oncall rotation discussion channel.

DevOncallBot: scheduled: oncall rotation review meeting added - 2026-04-01 16:00 UTC. Organizer: Jordan Kim.

Asha Patel: for the manager backfill, recruiting will open req 5473. interviewing hiring committee: Maya, Jordan, and Lina. were prioritizing candidates with ops + mentorship experience.

Maya R.: please CC me on final offer approvals, want to ensure budget alignment.

Ben Wallace: quick Q 1 will the manager be full-time people manager or hybrid IC+manager?

Asha Patel: manager role is full people manager for oncall squad; some technical runway expected but not individual contributor backlog.

Jordan Kim: note: short-term schedule impact: well run 2 week overlap between Ben and the outgoing lead to transfer pagers. outgoing lead finish date 2026-04-22.

Lina Chavez: added tentative 1:1s and runbook walkthrough invites for Ben next week.

Maya R.: thanks team. goal: eliminate single-person pager ownership and stabilize MTTR within 4 weeks of hires. will post a short org chart once manager req is live. :white_check_mark:

Asha Patel: recruiting action items: post req 5473 by EOD, prioritize internal referrals, schedule hiring committee calendar invites.

Ben Wallace: thanks all. looking forward to meeting everyone. :party:
file_notes: Announcement thread in people-ops about oncall manager backfill and two hires (one accepted). Includes recruiting actions, onboarding owners, and calendar bot message.
